annotations.title: Agent email inbox: a receive-only address for 1, 7 or 30 days, verification codes and links pulled out

description: Use when an agent must receive email: sign-up codes, magic links, or ongoing mail. Input: days (1 default, 7, 30). Output: address @inbox.1gateway.dev, id, one-time secret, read and extend URLs. Reads are free (header x-inbox-secret): sender, subject, text, codes and confirmation links extracted. Receive only; 20/50/200 messages, 256 KB each, attachments dropped; mail kept 30 days. Extendable. Use instead: agent_webhook for HTTP callbacks; email_check for checking an address. Example: GET /v1/agent/inbox?days=7 Price: $0.01–$0.1 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

days.description: How long the address lives: 1 (default, $0.01), 7 ($0.03) or 30 days ($0.1)
